svg.title: Fixed eyes for a 160 by 96 block arena
svg.desc: 4 by 3 eyes at the centers of equal cells. Each eye loads 7 by 7 chunks; together they load 154 chunks around a 60-chunk arena. The highlighted eye reaches its cell corners at 25.6 blocks, within the 32-block tracking range.
svg.text: Fixed eyes for a 160 × 96 block arena
Smallest tracking range 32 blocks, largest view distance 8. Every cell corner lies within reach of its eye.
Margin: loaded and recorded, though outside the region
